cards.english: I come from America, and you?
Have you ever been to Egypt?

xīngqīyī xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn yí kè

cards.english: Is it hot where you are today?

cards.hanzi: 我这里今天不热。昨天也不热。
cards.pinyin: Wǒ zhèlǐ jīntiān bú rè. Zuótiān yě bú rè.
cards.english: It's not hot here today. It wasn't hot yesterday either.

cards.pinyin: Shàng gè yuè wǒ zài Zhōngguó, Zhōngguó hěn rè.
cards.english: I was in China last month. It was very hot in China.
China is very hot this summer.

Nín de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
Wǒ bù chī, xièxie. Wǒ bú è.
cards.english: I don't eat it, thanks. I am not hungry.
What time do you eat breakfast?

cards.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān jǐ diǎn chī de wǔfàn?
cards.english: What time did you have lunch today?

cards.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān shíèr diǎn chī de wǔfàn.
Wǒ kě le / Wǒ hěn kě.
Nǐ jīntiān zuò yùndòng le ma?
